content:
The ***Fallout S.P.E.C.I.A.L. Anthology*** is a collection of seven of the *Fallout* games, including *Fallout*, *Fallout 2*, *Fallout 3*, *Fallout: New Vegas*, *Fallout 4*, *Fallout 76* and *Fallout Tactics*, as well as all of their add-ons. [1] 

The collection was announced on February 19, 2024, intended to promote the *Fallout* series with the TV show premiering soon. Pre-orders also opened on February 19. The set was released on April 11, 2024, worldwide.

The anthology includes the seven *Fallout* games as previously mentioned, with *Fallout 3* and *Fallout 4* being Game of the Year Editions, as well as *Fallout: New Vegas*'s Ultimate Edition. The collection does not include physical copies of the games; rather, download codes are provided for each of the seven games.

Like the *Fallout Anthology* (2015) that preceded it, the *Fallout S.P.E.C.I.A.L. Anthology* is packaged in a unique case shaped like a mini nuke, which makes "audible bomb sounds." Seven cards for the SPECIAL attributes (Strength, Perception, Endurance, Charisma, Intelligence, Agility and Luck) are included, and fit inside of the case. Each of the SPECIAL cards also contains the download code for one of the games. Although the SPECIAL system has been a mainstay of the *Fallout* series, the design of these cards was inspired by *Fallout 76*'s perk cards. [1]
